craft_notes: Sthāyin vismaya settling into praṇaya (maṅgala wonder at manifest greatness). Firing rows: twin means (speech/seeing) → dash caesura splitting them; verb-first jayati → arrival kept mid-line-2 ('triumphs'); vowel arc bright steal/watch → dark high. lines: Through honeyed lips that steal the mind — through watcher and the watched,
triumphs the Lord whose power is joy paraded: God on high.
